facts.business: TVS Motor Company Limited manufactures and sells motorcycles, scooters, mopeds, three-wheelers, and electric vehicles, with a focus on personal and commercial mobility across domestic and international markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company expects India two-wheeler and three-wheeler demand in FY 2026-27 to broadly track the previous year's performance, subject to external developments.

key_risks: Higher fuel prices and inflationary pressures
Geopolitical developments impacting trade flows, energy prices, raw material costs and financial markets
El Niño event weighing on monsoon patterns and rural incomes
Tariff actions, trade fragmentation and geopolitical tensions reshaping supply chains
Disruptions to key maritime routes leading to higher freight and insurance costs
AI impact on consumption economies through job displacement and slower wage growth
